title: W1 fix adds _focus_seconds to the review form but no client code ever populates it — real-browser submits still report 0 (still present since r1)
detail: Never populated: reference_form.js binds only .ref-question forms and the review form is not one — real browsers still post the hardcoded '0', so focus_seconds_reported stays 0. W1's observable bug persists; only crafted POSTs (the new tests) exercise non-zero.
recommended_fix: Extend reference_form.js so the review page writes the running focus accumulator into its [data-focus-seconds] field before native submit (or hand the last measured value across navigation), then extend the flow test to cover the real client path.
